title: Proposer-Agent-Evaluator (PAE): Autonomous Skill Discovery For Foundation Model Internet Agents
reviewed_version: PMLR volume 267 published original; retrieved exact supplied PDF URL
summary: Major scope error in complete-pipeline unseen-domain interpretation; local arithmetic, objective and evaluation implementation issues; reported empirical gains are not declared false.

problems.title: Unseen-website test domains were used in SFT
problems.claim: Final agent zero-shot generalization to unseen websites.
problems.assumptions: Interpret unseen across the complete task-specific SFT+RL training pipeline.
problems.evidence: Appendix explicitly identifies same sites for SFT demonstrations and later test. 65 URLs printed for stated85.
problems.counterevidence: Unseen by the later RL stage is a legitimate narrower meaning; held-out instructions and gains relative to SFT may survive. Disclosure is explicit.
problems.impact: Core novel-domain generalization inference is not established by this design; no claim of identical instruction memorization.
problems.correction: Restrict conclusion or evaluate domains excluded from SFT and RL.
problems.repair_verification: New experiment not performed; domain identity is documented in manuscript.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read original abstractp1, Sections5.2-5.3 pp6-8, Table3p7, AppendixF pp17/22 and Figs20-21pp30-31. Actually viewed pp7,30,31, including captions explicitly linking SFT sites and generalization evaluation.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: Issue is conditional on the broad final-agent, complete task-specific SFT+RL meaning of unseen websites. It is not a claim of hidden pretraining exposure, identical test-task reuse or a false gain against SFT. The narrower post-SFT PAE-stage interpretation must be considered.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: AppendixF states all11220 trajectories are used in SFT and RL starts from this checkpoint; both website-list captions say these sites are also used for zero-shot generalization evaluation. Thus excluded-from-RL does not imply excluded-from-agent-training. A fresh count from exact physical PDF pages gives35+30=65 unique URL strings; headings are seen-site categories, not20 extra unseen URLs.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: The paper consistently frames PAE as later RL in several places, and it explicitly discloses SFT. Under that stage-specific interpretation Table3 remains a legitimate transfer/retention test:9.1to16.3 and16.1to21.4 gains survive. Site familiarity does not alone explain those incremental gains because it is common to baseline and final agent; it limits claims about genuinely new domains. No misconduct or memorized-instruction assertion is justified.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Major retained only for the central unqualified claim that final agents generalize zero-shot to domains absent from all task-specific training, not for disclosed RL-stage transfer. Qualifying all claims resolves wording scope; maintaining the broader result needs a new SFT-and-RL-held-out domain split and evaluation. The65/85 list mismatch is a local completeness issue, not evidence all85 were identically trained/tested without IDs.

problems.title: Reported gains and weighted means disagree with tables/counts
problems.assumptions: Fixed weights108/50/50, common averaging window, one-decimal rounding.
problems.evidence: PAE25.365 not24.6; demo26.556 not25.7; Claude49.454 not50.1. 7B WebArena gain6.6 not10.8; 34B WebVoyager10.8 not10.4.
problems.counterevidence: Different denominators/windows could explain weighted means but are not specified; direction of gains survives.
problems.correction: Publish per-task outcomes, denominators and aggregation; correct arithmetic.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read counts on p5, Table1/Section5.3p6, Table2p7, p8 human-study statement; actually viewed Table2 and Figure4p9 to read all seven bar pairs.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Fresh rational weighted means under108/50/50 follow below. If components and total are rounded to0.1, aggregate discrepancy can be at most0.1 percentage point; the three highlighted gaps exceed this. A common linear running-average operator with fixed weights commutes with weighted summation. Different denominators or smoothing/checkpoint windows could explain it but require evidence. Direct Table2/1 subtraction gives7B WebArena6.6 and34B WebVoyager10.8; p8 itself also states the latter10.8, while the separate Qwen72B comparison is10.4.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: The SFT18.0365 rounds18.0 and gain directions remain. Figure4 human gain12.5to26 supports improvement beyond agreement with Claude; the pooled confusion matrix does not prove equal per-model calibration. The1.92857 versus1.7 system difference assumes the seven displayed models equally weighted, so a different aggregation is an unresolved explanation rather than proof of underlying data error.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for definite gain prose errors and conditional displayed aggregation inconsistencies. Publish denominators, raw outcomes and common-window definitions; do not attribute any gap to the release coverage defect without run linkage.

problems.title: Release replay, shortest-success filtering and normalized token loss differ from exact on-policy identity
problems.assumptions: Counterexample one-step binary rewards A~Bernoulli1,B~Bernoulli.8; currentpA.8 replayqA.1.
problems.evidence: Currentlogitgradient+.032 versus replayweighted-.556; length2/10quantile3.6 retains2 only; clipping commented.
problems.counterevidence: Fresh success cloning gradient is valid up to positive scale; Alg1 explicitly accumulates D; replay may help empirically. Release configurations may be examples.
problems.impact: Cannot treat released heuristic as unbiased current REINFORCE or literal all-success cloning. Historical scores not implicated.
problems.correction: Document/ablate replay and extra filtering; distinguish motivation and implemented objective.
problems.repair_verification: Exact elementary example; no author program run.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read p5 Section4.4 on-policy trajectory definition and all-success statement, p14 practical replay Algorithm1 and p24 hyperparameters. Read onpolicy_train_loop171-190, utils52-68, trainer35-39/72-90, llava_agent122-152, interface133-159 and supplied single-server configuration.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: For fixed sampling policy and binary terminal reward, conditioning its score-function gradient on success gives a positive normalization. This identity assumes full trajectory log-probability sums and on-policy distribution at the sampling parameter; repeatedly updating against replay does not preserve it automatically.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: With binary success probabilitiesA1/B.8, currentpA.8 and oldqA.1, fresh exact logit gradients are+.032 and-.556 respectively; conditioning the replay on success divides by.82 and keeps the opposite sign. Same-task successful lengths2,10 produce linear20th percentile3.6 and retain2 only. Agent get_log_prob calls interface returning token mean, then BCTrainer averages those action values: this is not the displayed token-sum trajectory likelihood when lengths differ.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Algorithm1 explicitly accumulatesD; replay is not hidden and may be a useful heuristic. Fresh-policy identity is valid, and the counterexample says nothing about the empirical utility of the published update. Main-snapshot clipping call is commented; supplied yaml rollout256/epoch1 differs from table4096/4 but has placeholder paths and could be illustrative. Historical settings are unverified.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Minor release/method-description issue retained. Qualify REINFORCE equivalence, document replay/shortest filtering/token normalization, and provide matched configuration; no universal failure or historical outcome inference.

problems.title: Released evaluator drops remainder tasks and randomizes index zero
problems.assumptions: Supplied evaluation path, random_taskFalse, N tasks, no environment failures.
problems.counterevidence: Alternative launchers/historicalcode not established; evaluation trajectories stored separately from training.
problems.impact: Release metrics may not cover intended complete test set. No claim this caused published discrepancies.
problems.correction: Retain remainder and use task_id is not None; verify task-ID coverage.
problems.repair_verification: Independent finite enumeration; proposed code fix not executed.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read scripts/run90-101, WebBroswerGym.reset537-553, BatchedWebEnv.reset937-944 and onpolicy_train_loop evaluation102-124/211-231. Additional static read of env_utils.batch_interact_environment confirms one batch for num_trajectories=env.batch_size, env.reset enumeration and no remainder recovery.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: Describes supplied nonrandom task enumeration, requested countN, successful environment interactions and one evaluation call. Repeated calls can eventually sample some omitted tasks in the random slot; this is not a proof of permanent impossibility across all runs.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: batch=8floor(N/8), indices1..batch-1 are fixed and index0 falls through to uniform random.choice. Fresh exact finite enumeration over every possible random index gives results below. For557, fixed551 plus six candidate unseen indices yields551+6/557. For208, full coverage requires randomzero, probability1/208.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Evaluation trajectories are saved separately from train_trajectories; the inspected update never appends them. Safe action batching partitions actions but does not restore omitted task slots. Alternate launchers and historical byte linkage are unknown; failed resets/retries would further change observations and were not modeled.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Minor release defect retained. Use explicit None check and preserve/rebatch remainders, then verify unique task IDs. Proposed repair was not executed against a live website or author runtime.

problems.title: Whole-response substring parser differs from final-verdict semantics
problems.assumptions: Free-form reasoning before verdict as requested by prompt.
problems.evidence: UNSUCCESSFUL yields1; hypothetical NOT SUCCESS in reasoning followedby finalSUCCESS yields0.
problems.counterevidence: Ordinary canonical strings correctly parsed; historical incidence unknown.
problems.correction: Structured or anchored final verdict; malformed rejection.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read p21 Fig13 prompt requiring reasoning followed by definitive SUCCESS/NOT SUCCESS, and utils_eval469-585 including final screenshot selection and566-568 predicate.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Independently written equivalent substring predicate returns1,0,1,0 for canonical success, canonical failure, UNSUCCESSFUL-only response, and reasoning mentioning NOT SUCCESS followed by a successful final verdict. The latter is permitted free-form reasoning under the prompt but is misread by whole-response matching.

inputs: If incomplete it would be NOT SUCCESS. All requirements are met. Verdict: SUCCESS.

independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Canonical verdict-only outputs work. Functional WebArena evaluation takes a separate branch when task eval metadata exists; this Claude-parser issue is not a universal defect of every evaluation. Historical malformed-output incidence is unavailable. Last-three-image input is implemented; whether those images establish all conditions depends on the task.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Minor robustness issue retained; parse an explicit final structured field and reject malformed responses. No live model calls or historical score-impact claim.

problems.title: Uncertainty, evaluator calibration and stage-specific autonomy
problems.evidence: Running means lack full windows/seed uncertainty; pooled positive predictive value83.1%; ClaudeSFT and handwrittenMap examples remain.
problems.counterevidence: Human7Bgain12.5to26; functional WebArena verification; relevant ablations and explicit appendix disclosures.
problems.impact: Do not infer small-gap significance, causal skill mechanism, fully unassisted initialization or complete proprietary-free pipeline.
problems.correction: Raw paired results, selection split, calibration per model and training-stage qualifications.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read pp4-9 model/evaluation descriptions, p15 author-provided demos and five-annotator process, pp17/22 Claude SFT, p23 original-vs-Easy benchmark/limitations, p24 hyperparameter choices, p25 handwritten Map examples, pp28-29 detailed prompts. Viewed pp7/9 learning curves and pp20/39 qualitative counterexamples.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Unknown paired labels, repeated-seed variability and selection windows prevent significance inference for tiny0.1/0.7-point comparisons. PPV83.06% is conditional on an auto-positive in the pooled matrix, while agreement91.4% is prevalence-dependent; neither calibrates every model/task. Map examples and Claude SFT restrict names-only/proprietary-free claims to the appropriate stage. Figure3 no-reasoning starts at a different SFT capability, so it does not isolate an RL-only reasoning intervention.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Human200-trajectory-per-method study and7B gain13.5 points, ground-truth WebArena checks, disclosed prompts and ablations remain useful evidence. Author-selected optional demos are openly stated. Original WebArena rewriting is disclosed; no test-set tuning, deliberate concealment or fictitious result is inferred. Figure12 shows both403 and unsupported final content, so categories can overlap without proving wrong coding. Figure30 screenshot/final answer does not certify exclusion of every24-hour business, but this is not an independently verified failed benchmark item.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained for small-gap significance, mechanism, calibration and broad autonomy language. Request task-level paired outcomes, selection protocol, seed uncertainty and stage-specific descriptions. Scope remains these existing claims; no entire-pipeline absence-of-issues certificate or empirical replication.

limitations: No author programs executed and no empirical replication.
Datasets, checkpoints, full human labels, complete split identifiers and historical run-to-code linkage unavailable/unverified.
External references and other manuscript revisions not checked; optional separate OpenReview attachment unavailable.
